CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   B. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   C. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)

   C. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   B. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the lost coin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the mustard seed and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trust: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust
